0.long_answer: Cystic hygroma, also known as a lymphatic malformation or water tumor, is a congenital malformation of the lymphatic system characterized by fluid‐filled cysts. When such a malformation is diagnosed in the second trimester, it is typically associated with Turner syndrome. This syndrome involves a complete or partial absence of one of the sex chromosomes in females and is known to be linked with cystic hygroma when detected early in pregnancy.
